description: SAR-FuseSeg 4-class mapping from CORINE Land Cover (CLC2018) / BigEarthNet v2.0 43-class nomenclature reference maps to {built-up, water, vegetation, other}. Documented per Implementation_Plan_v1.2.md (versioned class mapping requirement).
source_labels_reference: CORINE Land Cover 2018 nomenclature as rasterized into BigEarthNet v2.0 Reference_Maps (pixel-level, coarse: CLC minimum mapping unit is 25 ha / 100 m, resampled onto 10 m Sentinel-2 grid -> inherently coarse near class boundaries).
notes: Wetlands are grouped under 'water' (saturated/water-adjacent land cover) rather than 'vegetation'; this is a documented judgement call, not a CORINE default.
Any CLC class not listed here (e.g. bare rock, burnt areas, glaciers - rare in the BigEarthNet acquisition window) falls back to 'other'.

Reference-map pixels with no valid CLC code, or that fall in the seasonal-snow/cloud/shadow-affected patch list published alongside BigEarthNet v2.0, are mapped to ignore_index (255) rather than guessed.
